The presence of a human hand emerging from a typewriter is a clear hallucination that violates the class definition of a 'space bar'. image_description: A surreal, AI-generated image depicting a vintage typewriter case that has been morphed with organic and mechanical elements. The 'keyboard' area features standard typewriter keys on the left, but transitions into a smooth, blank white surface on the right where a space bar would be. Disturbingly, a realistic human hand emerges from the bottom right of the casing, appearing to fuse with the metal/plastic body. The interior of the case shows typewriter mechanisms (typebars) but lacks a coherent structural connection to the keys.
